description.en: The ID of the virtual border router (VBR) instance.

description.zh:
VBR实例所属的阿里云账号ID（主账号）。

>如果您要加载跨账号的网络实例，本参数必填。
description.en:
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the VBR instance belongs.

> This parameter is required if you attach a network instance that belongs to another Alibaba Cloud account.
The region where the VBR instance is located.

description.zh: 网络实例的类型，取值：**VBR**边界路由器。
description.en: The type of the network instance. Set the value to **VBR**. VBR specifies a virtual border router.

description.zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

> 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的**RequestId**作为**ClientToken**标识。每次API请求的**RequestId**不一样。
description.en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a unique parameter value from your client for each request. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the **RequestId** of the request as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** of each request is different.

description.zh: 子实例的描述信息。长度为0～128个字符。
description.en: The description of the child instance. The description must be 0 to 128 characters in length.

description.zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
- **true**：发送检查请求，不会修改服务资源。
- **false**（默认值）：发送正常请求。
description.en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

- **true**: Performs a dry run to check the request without modifying service resources.

- **false** (default): Sends the request.
The ID of the ECR instance.

title.zh: 加载子实例至专线网关（ECR）

descriptions.zh: 在调用**AttachExpressConnectRouterChildInstance**接口加载子实例（VBR）至专线网关之前，请确保专线网关的状态为**Active**。
descriptions.en: Before you call the **AttachExpressConnectRouterChildInstance** operation to attach a child instance (VBR) to an ECR, make sure that the ECR is in the **Active** state.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun expressconnectrouter attach-express-connect-router-child-instance --ecr-id ecr-a5xqrgbeidz1w80000 --child-instance-id vbr-j6cwxhgg0s5nuephp0000 --child-instance-type VBR --child-instance-region-id cn-hangzhou --child-instance-owner-id 1905501448682345 --dry-run true --client-token 02fb3da4-130e-11e9-8e44-000000 --description test --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun expressconnectrouter AttachExpressConnectRouterChildInstance --region cn-hangzhou --ChildInstanceType VBR --Description test --EcrId 'ecr-a5xqrgbeidz1w80000' --DryRun true --ChildInstanceOwnerId 1905501448682345 --ClientToken '02fb3da4-130e-11e9-8e44-000000' --ChildInstanceId 'vbr-j6cwxhgg0s5nuephp0000' --ChildInstanceRegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
